WITH april_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
      AND d_year = 1999
),
return_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
catalog_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        item.i_item_id,
        item.i_item_desc,
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN april_dates ON april_dates.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store ON store.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    GROUP BY
        item.i_item_id,
        item.i_item_desc,
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number
),
store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN return_dates ON return_dates.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    GROUP BY
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN catalog_dates ON catalog_dates.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    s.i_item_id,
    s.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    MAX(s.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    MAX(r.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    MAX(c.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM store_returns_agg AS r
JOIN store_sales_agg AS s
    ON s.ss_customer_sk = r.sr_customer_sk
   AND s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk
   AND s.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
JOIN catalog_sales_agg AS c
    ON c.cs_bill_customer_sk = r.sr_customer_sk
   AND c.cs_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk
GROUP BY
    s.i_item_id,
    s.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    s.i_item_id,
    s.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
